_about: The tri-state region around New York City (the New York, New Jersey and Connecticut counties on the map), for engine/region/fetch_basemap.py, basemap.py, fetch_places.py, card.py, fetch_region.py and engine/tiles/buildings.sh (build-tiles.yml). bbox is [S, W, N, E]. parkMaxKm2 is higher than other cities' so Harriman State Park (about 190 km²) stays in. Parks and land use come from Geofabrik's state extracts (pbf): Overpass was too slow for this many tiles.
